about_us_page.title: Meet the Founders
about_us_page.subtitle: We love comfort, great vibes, board games, design, good coffee, feel safe and having lots of fun. That's why we created Undercover Vibe - a place where we unite all these passions.
about_us_page.mission_text: Our mission is to create a vibrant and inclusive community for board game enthusiasts. We believe in the power of board games to bring people together, foster creativity, and create lasting memories. Lets grow the board gaming culture and community in Estonia together!

hero.title: Coziest co-working in Tallinn
hero.subtitle: Perfect workspace by day. A VIP board game club by night.

comfort.title: Health-Conscious Comfort
comfort.description: Work in comfort with our ergonomic IKEA Markus chairs. Furniture and atmosphere designed for your well-being.

coffee.title: New coffee taste
coffee.description: We are buying most tasty coffee beans from local roasters to make your workday better. New coffee taste every month!

wifi.title: Blazing Fast Wi-Fi
wifi.description: Stay connected with our fiber-optic internet, ensuring smooth video calls and fast downloads.

atmosphere.title: Cozy & Quiet Atmosphere
atmosphere.description: Our space is designed to be a peaceful and productive environment, with quiet zones for focused work.

board_game_club.title: We love board games.
board_game_club.subtitle: Board games are a whole universe of exciting adventures, strategies, and fun. We've gathered the best for you.

collection.title: Game Collection
collection.description: Explore a vast and unique collection of board games, from classic strategies to the latest releases.

tables.title: Private Tables
tables.description: Enjoy your game nights in privacy and comfort with dedicated tables for you and your friends.

atmosphere_gallery.title: An Ambiance Crafted for You
atmosphere_gallery.description: Step into a space where thoughtful design meets ultimate comfort. Our interiors blend warm wood tones, soft ambient lighting, and plush furnishings to create an inviting atmosphere that feels both productive and deeply relaxing.

pricing_page.title: Our Pricing
pricing_page.subtitle: We offer flexible pricing options to suit your needs. Whether you're here for a day of work or a month of productivity, we have a plan for you.

monthly_desk.title: Monthly
monthly_desk.subtitle: discount till end of march
monthly_desk.description: Includes 24/7 access and all the perks of our community.

day_pass.title: Daily Pass
day_pass.description: Perfect for a day of focused work. Includes access to all common areas and amenities.

free_trial.title: Free Trial Day
free_trial.description: Pre-book a free trial day to experience our co-working space and see if it's the right fit for you.

boardgames_event_club.title: Own Boardgames event
boardgames_event_club.description: Host your own board game event nights at Undercover Vibe! Ideal for groups looking for a dedicated space to play and socialize.

boardgames_event_table.title: Own Boardgames table
boardgames_event_table.description: Reserve a private table for your board game events. Ideal for groups looking for a dedicated space to play and socialize.

boardgames_event_daily.title: Daily Pass
boardgames_event_daily.description: For various board game events and tournaments.

board_games_page.title: Our Board Games
board_games_page.description_1: We have a massive collection of over 1,000 board games! From classic strategy games to the latest releases, we have something for everyone. Our library is constantly growing, so there's always something new to discover.
board_games_page.description_2: You can browse our collection online or come into the cafe to see them for yourself. Our knowledgeable staff is always on hand to help you choose the perfect game and teach you the rules.

events_page.title: Upcoming Events
events_page.subtitle: Join our community for a variety of exciting events, from epic tournaments to casual game nights. There's always something happening at Undercover Vibe!

mafia.title: Mafia Night
mafia.description: A night of deception, deduction, and fun. Can you survive?

dnd.title: D&D for Beginners
